descriptionIntro.title: Operating principle
content: Imagine inviting a Discord bot for the game Conqueror's Blade. You apply a configuration to it and this configuration automatically sets up a website and a mobile application.

With these 3 apps, your users have the choice to fill out their barracks information via the website or mobile app and their hero information as well as their presence in territory wars via the Discord Bot, the website or the mobile app. A multi-platform system for your users.
And you, as a manager of territory wars, who do you win?
You can prepare for territory wars in a simplified and optimized way for groups via the website.

intro.title: Introduction
content: These General Conditions of Use (GCU) and confidentiality policy govern the use of the "Easy Management TW" services, including the 3 applications.

The GCU constitute the contract between the services offered called "Easy Management TW", access to the services is via one of the three applications. Access to the services implies unreserved acceptance of these Terms and Conditions of Use.

presentation.title: Presentation and objectives of the services
presentation.content: The "Easy Management TW" services give you access to a range of features that make it easier to manage your members and organise territory wars in the Conqueror's Blade game.

acces.title: Applications access
content: Access to the services requires internet. Internet access is at the user's expense.

Access to the Discord application requires installation on the Discord platform (Discord Inc.). This is done by clicking on the "Add to Discord" button on the home page of this website. Once on your Discord server, the command "/config" allows you to make the necessary settings for the 3 applications.
Access to the mobile application and the private area of this website requires the Discord bot to be installed and configured on the Discord server.
Access to the private part of the website is via OAuth2 Discord authentication of the user's account.
Access to the mobile application is via an access token generated by the command "/smartphone" via the Discord bot.
For maintenance or breakdown reasons, access to one or more applications may be suspended for a given or indefinite period.

Responsabilite.title: Responsibility
content: "Easy Management TW" cannot be held responsible for any misuse of its services. As a User, you therefore undertake to report any fault without exploiting it.
The site cannot be held responsible in the event of force majeure or the unforeseeable and insurmountable act of a third party.

collect.title: Personal data processed
collect.content: The personal data processed are as follows:
list: Discord information: ID, username, profile picture and roles on the Discord servers where the bot is installed
Conqueror's Blade game information: barracks (unit level and mastery), hero (level, class played, influence) and attendance at territory wars
Contributions: posts and replies published on the forum, comments about you written by your house managers
Login session: a random identifier valid for 30 days, stored in a cookie and in the database
No real name, email address, postal address, location, payment or advertising tracking data is collected

cookie.title: Cookies and browser storage
cookie.content: The website only uses a session cookie, which is strictly necessary for logging in.</br>The application also stores in your browser the chosen language, the selected house and your houses' logos (local storage), as well as a copy of its files for fast and offline start-up. When you log out or your session expires, the selected house and the logos are deleted from your browser.</br>No audience measurement or advertising cookie or tracker is used: no consent is therefore required.

use.title: Use of Information
use.content: The information collected is made available to users of the management group to enable them to prepare for turf wars. No other use is made of it.

storage.title: Data storage
storage.content: The data is stored as long as you are in a group associated with the Discord bot, if you are removed from the groups associated with the Discord bot, all your data is deleted from our database.</br>Similarly, if the Discord bot is removed from a discord (kicked or banned), all data concerning the house, the discord as well as the players in the associated groups are deleted from our database.

rgpd.title: Data protection
rgpd.content: We take the security of your data very seriously. We use industry-standard security measures to protect your information from unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure.

share.title: Sharing of information
share.content: We neither sell nor share your data with third parties.</br>Login goes through Discord (Discord Inc., United States): the application reads your ID, your username and the list of your Discord servers. This list is only used, in your browser, to display the up-to-date logo of your houses; it is never sent to our servers. Profile pictures and logos are displayed from Discord's servers.

Managers' comments are based on your house's legitimate interest in organising territory wars (article 6.1.f of the GDPR).

You can also leave the Discord groups linked to the bot: your data is then deleted.
If you encounter any difficulty, you can lodge a complaint with the CNIL, the French data protection authority (www.cnil.fr).
